# MessageGuide

> Bible study and William Marrion Branham sermons reader, with daily verses, cross-references, prayer board, testimonies, songs, and Message church directory.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of MessageGuide features.
- [About](/about): What MessageGuide is and who it serves.
- [Bible](/bible): Read scripture by book and chapter.
- [Reader](/reader): Focused Bible reading view.
- [Messages](/messages): WMB sermon library.
- [WMB Sermons](/wmb-sermons): Browse William Branham's sermons.
- [Message Reader](/message-reader): Read full sermon transcripts.
- [Cross References](/cross-references): Scripture-to-sermon connections.
- [Songs](/songs): Hymn and song book.
- [Daily Verse](/daily): Daily scripture and quote.
- [Events](/events): Community events.
- [Prayer Board](/prayer-board): Community prayer requests.
- [Testimonies](/testimonies): Shared testimonies.
- [Message Churches](/message-churches): Directory of Message churches.
- [Reading Plans](/plans): Structured Bible reading plans.
- [Help](/help): Help and support.
